@@U00966@@
With sweat and blood, sir,
The crown to belime.
(They handle the crown so clumsily that it breaks into two pieces, which
they then scamper about with.)
It’s done! He-he!
We speak and we see,
We hear and we rhyme—

@@U00968@@
(Looking into the mirror.)

@@U00969@@
Aiii! I think ’m going mad!

@@U00971@@
(Pointing to the MONKEYS.)

@@U00972@@
Now even my head’s beginning to reel.

@@U00974@@
And if the rhymes fit,
We've made a lucky hit,
And there’s a thought in it!

@@U00976@@
(Szill looking in the mirror.)

@@U00977@@
My heart’s on fire!
Let’s leave here! Quick!

@@U00979@@
(In the same posture as earlier.)

@@U00980@@
Let’s admit first, though,
that some poets are honest.
(The cauldron that the FEMALE MONKEY has failed to watch begins
to boil over and a great flame leaps out and shoots up the chimney and
down comes the WITCH through the flame with a horrible shriek.)

@@U00982@@
Ow! Ow! Ow! Ow!
Damn you! Damn you!
Blasted bitch!
You forgot the kettle
And burned the Witch!
translation:
@@U00966@@
先生，用汗水和鲜血，
皇冠值得信赖。
（他们处理王冠的方式非常笨拙，以至于它断成两截，
然后他们就到处乱跑。）
完成了！呵呵！
我们说话，我们看到，
我们听到并押韵——

@@U00968@@
（看着镜子。）

@@U00969@@
哎呀！我想我要疯了！

@@U00971@@
（指着猴子。）

@@U00972@@
现在连我的头都开始晕了。

@@U00974@@
如果押韵合适的话
我们幸运地击中了
而且还有一个想法在里面！

@@U00976@@
（席尔看着镜子。）

@@U00977@@
我的心着火了！
我们离开这里吧！快的！

@@U00979@@
（与之前的姿势相同。）

@@U00980@@
不过，我们首先要承认，
有些诗人是诚实的。
（母猴没能看到的大锅开始了
沸腾起来，一股巨大的火焰从烟囱里跳出来，
女巫带着可怕的尖叫声从火焰中下来。）

@@U00982@@
噢！噢！噢！噢！
该死的你！该死的你！
该死的母狗！
你忘记带水壶了
并烧死了女巫！
